title: Tennory
body:
# Tennory
Provided weapons from Warframe!

Now there are two types of weapons: Redeemer and Glaive.

Redeemer is a gunblade, which is used as a sword and shotgun.

![Item entity type of Redeemer.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mIX3BfQv/images/fbb060b9810f63fd475dd3028ff1e3126858c1be.png)

Glaive is a throwable weapon, its blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

![Item entity type of Glaive.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mIX3BfQv/images/4e71362edbe203874401ac3ba1d105c2e7e8ce66.png)
![Throwing a Glaive.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mIX3BfQv/images/7ac0739d681c964b4d1743d0197126a73a152d3a.png)

All weapons can be obtained from the Ominous Trial Spawner(2%) and Ominous Vault(20%).
